title: Standard Authorized Operational Access
description: Routine database read queries executed within normal business hours on non-sensitive tables that return modest row volumes are authorized and logged to the immutable audit trail for governance compliance.
automated_response: Log event hash to blockchain audit trail, permit immediate execution, maintain standard telemetry.

title: Honey Token Decoy Violation & Cryptographic Proof of Theft
description: Accessing or exfiltrating planted honey token records or cryptographically watermarked canary data represents definitive proof of unauthorized reconnaissance or data theft. Because honey tokens have zero legitimate operational purpose, touching one indicates confirmed malicious intent with 100% certainty.
automated_response: Instant zero-tolerance account freeze, isolate egress network traffic, trigger immediate smart contract trap alert, and generate certified Proof of Theft certificate for legal prosecution.

title: After-Hours Sensitive Data Access
description: Access to sensitive data tables (PII, financial, medical) outside of business hours (6 AM – 10 PM local time) requires prior written approval from a department manager.
automated_response: Generate alert, temporarily suspend query privileges on sensitive tables, notify SOC and users manager.

title: Bulk Data Download Threshold
description: Downloading or exporting more than 10,000 records from any production table in a single session is prohibited without DLP review. Queries returning bulk PII data must be intercepted and held for approval.
automated_response: Block the export, quarantine query results, generate a DLP incident, and require manager + DPO sign-off before release.

title: PII Access Without Business Justification
description: All queries accessing columns classified as Personally Identifiable Information (email, phone, SSN, credit card, address, date of birth) must have an associated business justification ticket.
automated_response: Log the access, mask query results until justification is provided, notify the Data Protection Officer.

title: Impossible Travel Detection
description: When a user authenticates or accesses data from two geographically distant locations within a time window that makes physical travel impossible, the session must be treated as a potential credential compromise.
automated_response: Immediately suspend the session, force MFA re-authentication, lock the account pending identity verification, and alert the SOC.

title: Privilege Escalation Monitoring
description: Any attempt to access tables, schemas, or resources beyond a users assigned role-based access level constitutes a privilege escalation attempt.
automated_response: Deny the query, log the attempt with full context, suspend the account after 3 violations, notify the security team.

title: Data Exfiltration Pattern Detection
description: Sequential queries that progressively extract data from sensitive tables especially when combined with unusual export formats or network destinations constitute an exfiltration pattern.
automated_response: Block all active sessions for the user, quarantine extracted data, initiate forensic investigation, preserve all audit logs.
